# Poaster API

> AI-powered social media automation for writers

## Base URL

https://my.poaster.app

All endpoints are versioned under `/v1/`. Full example: `https://my.poaster.app/v1/websites`

## Authentication

All requests require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

```
Authorization: Bearer po_liv...xxxx
```

API keys are created in Settings at https://my.poaster.app/settings. Keys start with `po_live_` and the raw token is shown only once at creation.

Only the endpoints documented below accept API keys. Other endpoints return 403.

## Endpoints

### Websites

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | /v1/websites | Create a website. Params: website[base_url], website[website_type] (generic or substack) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:id/retry | Re-queue website for AI evaluation |
| DELETE | /v1/websites/:id | Delete a website permanently |

### Webpages

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | /v1/websites/:website_id/webpages | Submit a URL for AI processing. Params: url (required), content (optional) |

### Posts

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| POST | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts | Create a post. Params: content (required), url (optional) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/:id | Update post content. Params: content (string or array). Cannot update sent posts |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/:id/approve | Approve a post (pending/rejected -> approved) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/:id/reject | Reject a post |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/:id/re_enqueue | Re-enqueue a post (-> approved, clears sent_at) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/:id/send_now_individual | Send post immediately. Requires share accounts |
| POST | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/send_now | Send multiple posts. Params: post_ids (array) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/bulk_approve | Bulk approve. Params: post_ids (array) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/bulk_reject | Bulk reject. Params: post_ids (array) |
| PATCH | /v1/websites/:website_id/posts/bulk_re_enqueue | Bulk re-enqueue. Params: post_ids (array) |

### Share Accounts

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| DELETE | /v1/share_accounts/:id | Delete a share account |
| PATCH | /v1/share_accounts/:id/x_oauth_refresh | Refresh X (Twitter) OAuth2 token |
| PATCH | /v1/share_accounts/:id/linkedin_oauth_refresh | Refresh LinkedIn OAuth2 token |

## Post Statuses

pending -> approved -> sent. Rejected is a terminal state unless re-approved.

## Website Statuses

queued -> in_progress -> done. failed can be retried.

## Service Types

x, linkedin

## API Versioning

All API endpoints are versioned under `/v1/`. When breaking changes are introduced, a new version prefix will be created (e.g., `/v2/`) alongside the existing version. Old versions will receive a `Deprecation` header with a `Sunset` date before removal.

## Error Codes

- 401: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing API key
- 403: Forbidden - Endpoint does not accept API keys, or resource belongs to another user
- 404: Not Found
- 422: Unprocessable Entity - Validation error

## Full Documentation

https://poaster.app/docs/
